responsibility: Implements GCC’s IPA devirtualization and ODR/type-inheritance infrastructure. It reconstructs and queries the type inheritance graph for polymorphic C++ types, computes possible virtual-call targets from OBJ_TYPE_REF and callgraph polymorphic metadata, supports speculative devirtualization, and reads/writes ODR-related LTO summaries including mismatch diagnostics such as One Definition Rule enum/type violations. This file is the IPA-wide type-graph and virtual-target analysis engine rather than a local callsite rewriter.
